# Vendored dependency

The root Cargo patch selects `parquet-57.0.0-decoder-v1`, based on Apache Parquet
57.0.0. See its [provenance](parquet-57.0.0-decoder-v1/ASSAY-PROVENANCE.md),
[license](parquet-57.0.0-decoder-v1/LICENSE.txt) and
[notice](parquet-57.0.0-decoder-v1/NOTICE.txt). Only the two documented decoder
files differ from upstream code. This source promotion does not publish packages.
